e.title: insurance_python (OSM)
e.summary: Open Source Modelling 精算 Python 算法合集（49★）：Smith-Wilson/Nelson-Siegel/Vasicek/Hull-White/Black-Scholes 等
e.summary_en: Open Source Modelling actuarial Python algorithm collection (49★): Smith-Wilson, Nelson-Siegel, Vasicek, Hull-White, Black-Scholes and more
e.summary_hk: Open Source Modelling 精算 Python 算法合集（49★）：Smith-Wilson/Nelson-Siegel/Vasicek/Hull-White/Black-Scholes 等
e.body: insurance_python（Open Source Modelling，49★，MIT）收录 OSM 发布过的精算/金融 Python 算法：Smith-Wilson 利率插值外推（[[yield-curve]] 实务标准）、Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 收益率曲线、Vasicek 单/双因子、Hull-White 单因子、Dothan、Black-Scholes、相关布朗运动、平稳 bootstrap 校准等。对 RIAA：利率建模是精算估值（准备金折现、偿付能力）的地基——Smith-Wilson 是 EIOPA 偿付能力 II 的无风险利率外推方法（[[ggsolvencyii]] 配套）；经典利率模型的一站式 Python 实现适合课程实验（[[rim540]] 及投资方向）；49★ 活跃度适中，MIT 可自由使用。
e.body_en: insurance_python (Open Source Modelling, 49★, MIT) collects the actuarial/financial Python algorithms published by OSM: Smith-Wilson interest rate interpolation/extrapolation (the [[yield-curve]] practice standard), Nelson-Siegel-Svensson yield curves, Vasicek one/two-factor, Hull-White one-factor, Dothan, Black-Scholes, correlated Brownian motion, stationary bootstrap calibration and more. For RIAA: interest-rate modelling is the foundation of actuarial valuation (reserve discounting, solvency) — Smith-Wilson is the EIOPA Solvency II risk-free rate extrapolation method (pairs with [[ggsolvencyii]]); one-stop Python implementations of classic rate models suit coursework experiments ([[rim540]] and investment track); 49★ with moderate activity, MIT freely usable.
e.body_hk: insurance_python（Open Source Modelling，49★，MIT）收錄 OSM 發佈過的精算/金融 Python 算法：Smith-Wilson 利率插值外推（[[yield-curve]] 實務標準）、Nelson-Siegel-Svensson 收益率曲線、Vasicek 單/雙因子、Hull-White 單因子、Dothan、Black-Scholes、相關布朗運動、平穩 bootstrap 校準等。對 RIAA：利率建模是精算估值（準備金折現、償付能力）的地基——Smith-Wilson 是 EIOPA 償付能力 II 的無風險利率外推方法（[[ggsolvencyii]] 配套）；經典利率模型的一站式 Python 實現適合課程實驗（[[rim540]] 及投資方向）；49★ 活躍度適中，MIT 可自由使用。
